title: Seven Ashina Spears - Shikibu Toshikatsu Yamauchi

sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
Seven Ashina Spears - Shikibu Toshikatsu Yamauchi (葦名七本槍 山内式部利勝, Seven Spears of Ashina Yamauchi Shikibu Toshikatsu) is an optional Mini-Boss with two Deathblow Counters.
As the Tenth Prayer Necklace states, the Seven Ashina Spears are Isshin's most loyal samurai who helped his rise to power.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Ashina Reservoir: during the second visit, in front of the Moon-View Tower, where The Divine Heir was once being held at in the prologue.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - As the final invasion of Ashina Castle and Outskirt by the Central Forces is triggered, this Mini-Boss will disappear for the rest of the playthrough. However, the Prayer Bead that he would have dropped will still be available in the offering box next to Hanbei for 2200 2200.
